reason: The factual premise holds. The dummy logs (_dl/biohub-exp58-x138-safe-lowref vs exp58t) show readmits 1365 vs 1337, +40 nodes after safe-div, geometric candidates 141 vs 155 and 230 vs 222, and safe-div forks 63 vs 62. So lowrefine is a tiny set-changer, not coordinate-only. The proposed rules still fail the value/transfer lens. (1) The ceiling from the metric is too small for the LB to resolve. Edge side: +29 edges out of ~120k gives |dJ| <= ~2.4e-4 even if every edge were a TP in an annotated region; realistically < 1e-4. Node multiplier: ~ -3e-5. Division term: one fork is ~0.1/450, about 2e-5. The coordinate part matches the closed 'float output coords' line (exp52 = exp51 on LB). A K2 display of 0.953 against #35's 0.954 would therefore come almost entirely from where #35 sits inside its rounding bin (P ~0.05-0.12), and it carries ~0 information about the private sign. Expected gain < 1e-5, not the claimed +1e-4. It also costs something: K1 is unscored in branch A, so dropping lowrefine needs a new scored file (a slot and a 7-8 h rerun), and K3 has to be rebuilt, which confounds K3 vs K2. R7 already forbids choosing between near-copies on 0.001; RT2 reverses that on noise. (2) Deleting §f fallback item 4 (#34) loses value. #34 is scored at 0.953 and admissible (L34 <= 6.46 h). In the world where the whole K family fails (e.g. a K2 hidden-run error, P ~2-5%), the chain would make F1 = exp52 = F2, a duplicated final, and forfeit max(x138_priv, exp52_priv). (3) The 'noncontrol' plateau is the LOOSER reading of an in-sample, network-confidence knob (DeepCenter was trained on all 199 videos). The edge-filter lesson (+0.016 local, 0 on LB) argues for the strict reading. (4) This item is correct but adds nothing: R5(b) already admits K2 (9.5 - 7.8 = 1.7 h >= 1 h). Only the procedural part survives: writing the rules down before the scores arrive.
fix: Keep the pre-commit timing, before K2 and exp60 results. Change the content. (1) Record lowrefine and forkmid honestly as small set-changers, but keep noise-aware thresholds. Keep lowrefine unless K2 <= #35 - 0.002 (a -0.001 display is rounding noise at a ~1e-4 true effect). For forkmid, require K3 >= K2 - 0.001 AND the exp60 audit's 0-TP-removed gate, and never spend a slot just to re-test lowrefine. (2) Keep #34 as fallback item 4, so F1 is never allowed to equal F2 = exp52. (3) Settle the DeepCenter plateau NOW with the STRICT reading, or with noncontrol plus confirmation >= +0.003 and 44b6 >= 0. It is an in-sample network-confidence knob, and R4's +0.002 LB bar still applies. (4) Keep the R5(b) note and keep the poller alive from 07:00 to 08:30 UTC for the 8.0 h insertion-gate check.
realistic_gain: ~0 in score (< 1e-5 expected from item 1; item 2 is slightly negative, ~ -5e-5, if applied as written). The only real value is procedural: two ambiguities resolved before the scores are seen.
